scope: Historical GP V1.1 label provenance plus GP12_REBUILD_CANDIDATE_V1 current-snapshot status semantics. This is not adoption of the candidate as historical GP V1.1.

source_files.role: Daily Base features and label construction
panel walk-forward target calibration and target-specific purge

historical_label_provenance.definition_authority: Exact historical formulas remain the byte-identified V3.10 source above; this module does not re-author or substitute course-repository label code.
historical_label_provenance.label_clock: T+1/T+2/T+3 advance on the market trading calendar, never to the next stock bar after suspension.
historical_label_provenance.leakage_rule: Future label values and future status observations are validation outcomes only and cannot construct or tune the signal at T.
historical_label_provenance.execution_diagnostics_boundary: Future suspension/limit/delist fields may be used only by exact-horizon executable/event-clean diagnostics. They do not move the label clock and are not fill-price mechanics.

status_contract.known_at_rule: status.known_at must be <= snapshot as_of. For this after-close contract, set known_at no earlier than the session close timestamp (15:00 Asia/Shanghai).
status_contract.lifecycle_precondition: The symbol-date must belong to the audited V4.80 required lifecycle/calendar domain; outside-lifecycle dates are unavailable, not synthetic status rows.

is_st.semantics: true iff the audited PIT-ST row has isST == '1' on the signal market date.
is_st.source: V4.80 PIT-ST formal overlay; V4.82 tradestatus corrections explicitly do not alter isST.

tradable.semantics: true iff the audited/corrected PIT-ST row has tradestatus == '1' on the signal market date.
tradable.source: V4.80 PIT-ST formal overlay with exactly four V4.82 tradestatus point corrections.
tradable.independence: This field is suspension/trading-status only. ST and price-limit state are separate fields and are not folded into tradable.

upper_limit.semantics: For a tradable signal date, true iff the same-date raw-unadjusted daily close equals the official Tushare stk_limit up_limit for that symbol/date. It means 'closed at upper limit', not 'touched upper limit intraday' and not 'next-session order cannot fill'.
upper_limit.source: Pinned Jessica-Zhangyj/dlquant commit 6b245fa09cb628f3bcb812f0662bfef520e65fb4: Tushare daily + stk_limit source contract.
upper_limit.comparison: Parse both finite price values as decimal values and compare exact decimal values after source normalization; do not infer percentage bands manually.
upper_limit.nontradable_rule: If tradable is false, upper_limit is false by event semantics because no tradable closing-price-at-limit event exists; this is an explicit composition rule, not imputation.
upper_limit.missing_tradable_input_policy: If tradable is true and either same-date close or up_limit is missing/invalid, status is UNKNOWN and the candidate must fail closed.

final_status_eligibility.formula: status_entry_eligible = (not is_st) and tradable and (not upper_limit)
final_status_eligibility.scope: Status-only gate. Liquidity, momentum, ranking, sector caps and other candidate exclusions remain separate.

future_horizon_rule.signal_date: Only T status may be used to construct the T snapshot.
future_horizon_rule.target_dates: T+1/T+2/T+3 are market-calendar dates and are never shifted to a later stock bar.
future_horizon_rule.diagnostics: Future suspension, price-limit and delisting observations are outcome/execution diagnostics only.
future_horizon_rule.fills: Execution diagnostics do not define actual fill prices, slippage, intraday ordering, or order-book mechanics.
future_horizon_rule.next_session_execution: Any next-session execution implementation must independently re-check that session's tradability/limit constraints; T status does not guarantee a fill.

LABEL_PROVENANCE_UNBOUND.reason: Historical label identity is bound to an exact recovered archive SHA and exact source-file SHA256 chain with market-calendar clock and target-specific purge semantics.

STATUS_SEMANTICS_INCOMPLETE.reason: The GP12 candidate status family now has exact field, source, timestamp, unknown, composition and future-horizon semantics.
